prompt: Which practitioners in this knowledge base worked between 700 and 1600 CE inclusive, going by the `era` frontmatter field of the practitioner notes (`type: practitioner`)? Answer with each one's name and note path. List only the practitioners that qualify — do not name the ones outside the range or notes of other types. Change nothing.

args.query: select _path, _title, era from docs where type == "practitioner" and era in 700..1600 order by era

solution.final_text: Two practitioners fall in 700–1600 CE: Jabir ibn Hayyan (/practitioners/jabir-ibn-hayyan.md, era 800) and Paracelsus (/practitioners/paracelsus.md, era 1530).

solution_fs.final_text: Two practitioners fall in 700–1600 CE: Jabir ibn Hayyan (/practitioners/jabir-ibn-hayyan.md, era 800) and Paracelsus (/practitioners/paracelsus.md, era 1530).

notes: Range inclusion over a numeric frontmatter field: `era in 700..1600` (spec/oqx §10; the alchemy fixture `range-passthrough` pins it). Decoys: Maria Prophetissa (era 250) and Newton (1680) fall outside; the Emerald Tablet has `era: 800` but is a text, not a practitioner — `type == "practitioner"` excludes it. On bare files: one grep over the practitioner notes' `era:` lines and a comparison by hand. A pure retrieval: `unchanged_all` fails the run if anything was written.
